---
name: Documentation, accessibility or scoped improvement
about: Propose a focused improvement grounded in an existing experience
---

## Problem and proposed outcome

Which learner/contributor task is difficult? Identify the workspace or document
and describe the resulting behavior you want.

## Scope and verification

Explain how to validate the change. Numerical/hardware proposals need independent
references, edge cases, flags and controlled measurements where applicable.
Distinguish observations from hypotheses; avoid unsupported performance claims.

## Contribution

Link related public evidence and describe whether you can help implement or test.
Do not include employer materials, private designs or secrets.
